instructions: 1. Run `GH_REPO=owner/repo gh stack merge 342 --yes --squash` in `owner/repo` to merge PRs #341, #342 of stack #35. One command lands every listed layer. Do not merge the layers one at a time with `gh pr merge`, and do not rebase or push between layers; GitHub retargets the remaining layers itself. If `gh stack` is an unknown command, run `gh extension install github/gh-stack`, then rerun that merge command. If `gh stack merge` reports `Merge conflict detected`, nothing was merged. Do not rerun the merge; update the stack from its bottom layer onto trunk with `gh stack rebase`, then `gh stack push`, following the Branch update playbook, and rerun the stack command.
2. After the merge attempt, rerun `pr-shepherd stack "owner/repo#35" --until-terminal --merge`; GitHub retargets the next layer onto `main`. Shepherd any layer that GitHub rejects or ejects.
